description: every Note kind: Normal and Rap to the Notes sum, Golden and Golden Rap to the golden sum, Freestyle adds nothing to the maximum and is never judged

players.comment: voiceValue = 2×1 + 1×2 + 2×1 + 1×2 = 8 (Freestyle 3×0 adds nothing), so a hit Beat earns 9000 / 8 × factor = 1125 × factor. Beat 0: C4 against pitch 0 (C), d = 0, hit, Normal +1125. Beat 1: d = 160 > 150, miss. Beat 2: d = 0, Golden +2250. Beat 3: voice without pitch on Rap, hit +1125. Beat 4: no voice, miss. Beat 5: a pitch on Golden Rap (pitch not checked), hit +2250. Beats 6–8: Freestyle, never judged.
